summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of JMIB MedTech Innovation Bridge. All 5 primary demo features validated: (1) Home hero + CTAs, (2) Header nav, (3) Submit flow -> Under Ministry Review badge -> view detail with AI panel/disclaimer, (4) Featured challenge jmib-demo-001 shows AI panel with impact 92, RIMS 96% university card, VitalSense industry card, Express Interest toggles state, Offer Support dialog with Funding/Mentorship options and confirm records offer, (5) Lifecycle timeline advances to final Impact stage and stops (advance button becomes disabled). Explore search filter and Ministry Dashboard (6 stat cards, Demo Data badges, sidebar toggle) all functional. No browser console errors detected (stderr logs shown are unrelated k8s cron webhook noise, not browser JS errors).

spec_mismatches.impact: MINOR - all 6 cards render correctly with proper 'Demo Data' badges and values. Only the middle 4 testid keys differ from spec's suggested names. Functionally equivalent; only affects automated test selectors.

action_items: OPTIONAL: If strict spec compliance is desired, rename Dashboard stat card keys in /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx (lines 45-48) to: 'ai-triaged', 'university-matched', 'industry-partnered', 'in-pilot' to match the review request spec. Currently they use different (equally valid) labels.
critical_code_review_comments: All primary user flows work end-to-end with no console errors.
State properly persisted to localStorage under key 'jmib_challenges_v2'.
AI disclaimer text ('AI-assisted analysis, not medical diagnosis...') correctly rendered.
Lifecycle advance correctly stops at final stage (Impact) - button becomes disabled after reaching index 9.
seed_data_creation: Test challenge 'TEST_Portable pulse oximeter for PHCs' created via UI submit form during test run (stored in localStorage of test browser only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully frontend + localStorage. Use localStorage.clear() at test start for deterministic state. All interactive elements have kebab-case data-testids. Dashboard stat card testids diverge slightly from spec but 6 cards render correctly. All charts (bar, area, pie, district) render with Demo Data badges. Sidebar toggle works.
